texts.preamble: Food Safety Officer'S Association vs Union Of India And Ors on 12 April, 2016 -1- Cwp No.15330 of 2012 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh Cwp No.15330 of 2012 (O&M) Date of decision: 12.04.2016 Food Safety Officer's Association ....Petitioner Versus Union of India and others ....Respondents Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Paramjeet Singh Dhaliwal 1) Whether Reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment ? 2) To be referred to the Reporters or not ? 3) Whether the judgment should be reported in the Digest ?
texts.facts: Instant writ petition has been filed for quashing the order dated 19.06.2012 (Annexure P-18) and order dated 20.07.2012 (Annexure P- 19) and for directing the State to appoint Designated Officers in accordance with the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'the Act') and Rules framed thereunder considering the claims of the petitioner association. As per provisions of the Act, no person can be given additional charge of Designated Officer as such the impugned notification is not valid one. Even the qualification for the post of Designated Officer has not been laid down. Food Safety Officer'S Association vs Union Of India And Ors on 12 April, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186389033/ 1 At this stage, learned counsel for the State submits that Government of Punjab, Department of Health and Family Welfare vide notification dated 31.03.2016 has already framed the Rules known as "Punjab Food and Drug Administration (Technical Group-A) Service Rules, 2016" wherein qualification in consonance with the provisions of the Act has been laid down. Copy of the notification dated 31.03.2016 is taken on record. In view of this, present petition is dismissed as infructuous.
